mapper.select: SELECT r.Re_Code, r.Re_Flag, r.Re_Name, r.Re_Remark, fc.Fc_Code, fc.Fc_Name, rc.Rc_ServSize1, rc.Rc_ServSize2, rc.Rc_ServSize3, ft.Tag_Code, ft.Tag_Type, ft.Tag_Name FROM F_Recipe r INNER JOIN F_RecipeCode rc ON rc.Rc_ReCode = r.Re_Code INNER JOIN F_FoodCode fc ON fc.Fc_Code = rc.Rc_FcCode LEFT JOIN F_FoodTagMap ftm ON ftm.Fc_Code = fc.Fc_Code LEFT JOIN F_FoodTag ft ON ft.Tag_Code = ftm.Tag_Code AND ft.Use_Yn = 'Y' WHERE r.Re_Code = #{reCode} ORDER BY rc.Rc_Seq, ft.Tag_Type, ft.Tag_Code

SELECT r.Re_Code, r.Re_Flag, r.Re_Name, r.Re_Remark, fc.Fc_Code, fc.Fc_Name, rc.Rc_ServSize1, rc.Rc_ServSize2, rc.Rc_ServSize3, ft.Tag_Code, ft.Tag_Type, ft.Tag_Name FROM F_Recipe r INNER JOIN F_RecipeCode rc ON rc.Rc_ReCode = r.Re_Code INNER JOIN F_FoodCode fc ON fc.Fc_Code = rc.Rc_FcCode LEFT JOIN F_FoodTagMap ftm ON ftm.Fc_Code = fc.Fc_Code LEFT JOIN F_FoodTag ft ON ft.Tag_Code = ftm.Tag_Code AND ft.Use_Yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.Re_Code, rc.Rc_Seq, ft.Tag_Type, ft.Tag_Code
